fact_keys.description: Energy reads: select exact needed keys from the output-plan catalog or available_fact_catalog. Omitting returns context/catalog only, no numeric model projection.

function.name: professional_read_many
function.description: 按明确record_ids（1到3个）逐项读取当前专业记录，包括已失效记录；ID决定专业类型，不猜类型。只读，不创建计算；适合多记录复核。返回各记录当前事实/限制和hash，随后仍需正式交付，读取成功不等于任务完成。

function.name: professional_deliver
function.description: 先读取delivery.kind对应记录，再提交statements及当前hash，核对值、单位、期间和面积。明确无定义字段保留null及来源原因；整条记录不完整、不适用或stale时改用professional_limit。

NumericDelivery.description: The model-facing numeric contract matches server validation exactly.

finish.description: True only for the last professional record you intend to deliver in this task. Ends model calls after successful validation; no extra prose turn needed.

energy_context.description: Energy facts require the exact source energy_context, including year, periods, carrier, boundary, data nature and basis. Old nonenergy facts use null.

fact.description: Copy explanation_facts.fact exactly; do not translate or use its label.

value.description: Copy source numeric string. Null requires source_undefined with unavailable_reason. Never invent values. Incomplete/stale record: professional_limit.

study_years.description: Required: copy the fact study_years; null for a non-period calculation.

area_m2.description: Required: copy fact area_m2. Null means no explicit area denominator; see area_basis. R/U are intrinsic area-normalized properties, not totals.
